QUOTE: derive_scope(repo_root, stated?) ├─ _declared_index_scope() tier 1 (stated via MCP options) or tier 2 (.clew.yaml) ... └─ otherwise whole_repo_scope()

VERDICT: HIT

WHY: The answer says a declared `index_scope` is preferred and that no section, a rejected declaration, or an unusable one all fall through to the whole-repo scope. It says "`derive_scope` absorbs a rejected declaration into the whole-repo tier," and "otherwise → whole_repo_scope()".
